meta.title: Rectangular waveguide modes and cutoff frequencies
meta.tools: Finite-difference Helmholtz eigenproblem on the waveguide cross-section (SciPy sparse eigensolver)
meta.summary: Solve for the TE and TM modes of a WR-90 X-band waveguide numerically, compare cutoff frequencies with f_c = (c/2)√((m/a)²+(n/b)²), and plot the field patterns of the lowest modes.
meta.problem: A hollow metal pipe only carries microwaves above a cutoff frequency. Which modes exist, and where do they start?
meta.theory:
Cross-section fields obey $\nabla_t^2\psi+k_c^2\psi=0$ with Dirichlet (TM, E_z) or Neumann (TE, H_z) walls. Rectangular a×b:
$k_c=\pi\sqrt{(m/a)^2+(n/b)^2}$, $f_c=ck_c/2\pi$. WR-90: a = 22.86 mm, b = 10.16 mm → TE₁₀ 6.557 GHz, TE₂₀ 13.11 GHz, TE₀₁ 14.76 GHz,
TE/TM₁₁ 16.15 GHz. Single-mode band 6.56–13.1 GHz.
meta.method:
Grid 92×41 points (0.25 mm). 5-point Laplacian with Dirichlet or Neumann (ghost-point) boundaries, smallest eigenvalues by shift-invert
Lanczos; f_c = c√λ/2π.
